name: @libre/wallet-embed
//: The @libre/* workspace packages MUST stay in devDependencies. They are never published to npm, and pnpm pack rewrites workspace:* to a bare version — so listing them as runtime dependencies makes every consumer's `npm i` 404. tsup bundles them into dist (noExternal in tsup.config.ts), so consumers need nothing at runtime. The release workflow's consumer-install gate enforces this.
